b8ee2ca63c49f9ff0995.en: The subject is who or what does the action. The verb must agree with it.
b8ee2ca63c49f9ff0995.id: Subjek (subject) adalah siapa atau apa yang melakukan tindakan. Kata kerja (verb) harus sesuai dengan subjeknya.

857ac4640c24654a3690.en: With one person or thing in the present, the verb often ends in -s.
857ac4640c24654a3690.id: Untuk satu orang atau benda pada waktu sekarang (present), kata kerjanya sering berakhiran -s.

51b01bce25948d1880d8.en: With more than one, the verb has no -s.
51b01bce25948d1880d8.id: Untuk lebih dari satu, kata kerjanya tanpa -s.

ce09750e24de053ffb74.en: Learn the pairs for one and for more than one.
ce09750e24de053ffb74.id: Pelajari pasangan kata untuk satu dan untuk lebih dari satu.

e46e6f714ffde519e348.en: Two subjects joined with and count as more than one.
e46e6f714ffde519e348.id: Dua subjek yang digabung dengan and dihitung lebih dari satu.

8c01d526d6baf875540b.en: Find the main word in the subject. In the box of crayons, the main word is box.
8c01d526d6baf875540b.id: Cari kata utama dalam subjek. Dalam the box of crayons, kata utamanya box.

1ac25ca9d4795d9d0583.en: Children is plural, like they, so we use are.
1ac25ca9d4795d9d0583.id: Children itu jamak (plural), seperti they, jadi kita memakai are.

43d12a1f9592f9ae9505.en: Is goes with one. Children means more than one.
43d12a1f9592f9ae9505.id: Is dipakai untuk satu. Children berarti lebih dari satu.

8d85518c1cf83b8c0b73.en: Was goes with one. Children means more than one.
8d85518c1cf83b8c0b73.id: Was dipakai untuk satu. Children berarti lebih dari satu.

d9cf35968ef313c401b9.en: Has does not fit this sentence.
d9cf35968ef313c401b9.id: Has tidak cocok untuk kalimat ini.

1209e558e4d29b8d1508.en: My sister is one person, like she, so we use has.
1209e558e4d29b8d1508.id: My sister adalah satu orang, seperti she, jadi kita memakai has.

75708d46cbe051b12437.en: The dog is one animal, like it. So the verb takes -s: the dog plays.
75708d46cbe051b12437.id: The dog adalah satu hewan, seperti it. Jadi, kata kerja (verb) mendapat -s: the dog plays.

58ed4fb7e5f7fc89c5b5.en: With one dog, the verb needs -s.
58ed4fb7e5f7fc89c5b5.id: Dengan satu dog, kata kerjanya perlu -s.

6db7894d8d9bebd9a3f8.en: Playing needs a helper word, like is playing.
6db7894d8d9bebd9a3f8.id: Playing perlu kata bantu, seperti is playing.

90d6c0793b3079bbba0a.en: Are play is not correct English.
90d6c0793b3079bbba0a.id: Are play bukan bahasa Inggris yang benar.

69f0d7e3209a7e027b2b.en: Birds is plural, like they, so we use are: the birds are singing.
69f0d7e3209a7e027b2b.id: Birds itu jamak (plural), seperti they, jadi kita memakai are: the birds are singing.

fe957d8fb660cc1b98ca.en: Is goes with one. Birds means more than one.
fe957d8fb660cc1b98ca.id: Is dipakai untuk satu. Birds berarti lebih dari satu.

37ed6aa57e32ccb0ba48.en: Was goes with one. Birds means more than one.
37ed6aa57e32ccb0ba48.id: Was dipakai untuk satu. Birds berarti lebih dari satu.

cd4b4d8f527aa0113feb.en: Shoes is plural, so we use are.
cd4b4d8f527aa0113feb.id: Shoes itu jamak (plural), jadi kita memakai are.

ad80f577dda26c549665.en: Ana and Kofi are two people, like they, so we use were.
ad80f577dda26c549665.id: Ana dan Kofi adalah dua orang, seperti they, jadi kita memakai were.

ed83c69ed59404458740.en: My brother is one person, like he, so we use goes.
ed83c69ed59404458740.id: My brother adalah satu orang, seperti he, jadi kita memakai goes.

f325c9dfc6523a30ba51.id: Kalau hanya satu orang, go perlu -es.

31bfe37d3beab9f4a4b9.en: Are goes with more than one.
31bfe37d3beab9f4a4b9.id: Are dipakai untuk lebih dari satu.

10470c84dfc497e7dd5e.en: The cat, my teacher, the sky and everyone take is. The children, Sam and Lina, the mangoes and the books take are.
10470c84dfc497e7dd5e.id: The cat, my teacher, the sky, dan everyone memakai is. The children, Sam and Lina, the mangoes, dan the books memakai are.

977db287b615fce97ff3.en: The girls is plural, like they, so we use have.
977db287b615fce97ff3.id: The girls itu jamak (plural), seperti they, jadi kita memakai have.

b15062e3bf4aeb9ba512.en: Girls is plural, so it needs have.
b15062e3bf4aeb9ba512.id: Girls berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi perlu have.

9b16a5ae5ab519d4688e.en: Girls is plural, so is does not fit.
9b16a5ae5ab519d4688e.id: Girls berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi is tidak cocok.

5163fb88898210c348bc.en: Cats is plural, so we use do: Do your cats like fish?
5163fb88898210c348bc.id: Cats itu jamak (plural), jadi kita memakai do: Do your cats like fish?

5b5df861c5035fae2097.en: The main word is box, and there is one box. So we use is, even though crayons is plural.
5b5df861c5035fae2097.id: Kata utamanya adalah box, dan hanya ada satu box. Jadi, kita memakai is, walaupun crayons itu jamak (plural).

8bd33343ebead9d5d540.en: The verb goes with box, not with crayons.
8bd33343ebead9d5d540.id: Kata kerjanya mengikuti box, bukan crayons.

c9bb070593df30891f17.en: Were goes with more than one, but there is one box.
c9bb070593df30891f17.id: Were dipakai untuk lebih dari satu, padahal box hanya ada satu.

abe277b8f9e4d796ce79.en: Have does not fit in this sentence.
abe277b8f9e4d796ce79.id: Have tidak cocok di kalimat ini.

d1adb02a0dad59f36150.en: The leaves are turning brown. On the tree only tells us where the leaves are, so the verb agrees with leaves.
d1adb02a0dad59f36150.id: The leaves are turning brown. On the tree hanya memberi tahu letak daun-daun itu, jadi kata kerja (verb) mengikuti leaves.

3d4a196ad9f881132516.en: The verb goes with leaves, not with tree.
3d4a196ad9f881132516.id: Kata kerjanya mengikuti leaves, bukan tree.

27a75c8aa53bcfa1b6a3.en: Was goes with one, but there are many leaves.
27a75c8aa53bcfa1b6a3.id: Was dipakai untuk satu, padahal leaves ada banyak.

ed15815bb7c48e6ab2b7.en: Rina and Joko are two people, so walk is right. The sun is one thing, so shines is right.
ed15815bb7c48e6ab2b7.id: Rina dan Joko adalah dua orang, jadi walk benar. The sun adalah satu benda, jadi shines benar.

309b546ea89dd9cd8955.en: The baby is one, so it should be cries.
309b546ea89dd9cd8955.id: The baby hanya satu, jadi seharusnya cries.

e29ddffa89b2b5e79059.en: Friends is plural, so it should be were.
e29ddffa89b2b5e79059.id: Friends berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi seharusnya were.

ea8f1fc813fa90317108.en: Each means every single child, one at a time. So the verb is singular: each of the children has a book.
ea8f1fc813fa90317108.id: Each berarti setiap anak, satu per satu. Jadi, kata kerjanya (verb) tunggal (singular): each of the children has a book.

3dafc3ae15cb35677945.en: Each means every one on its own, so we use has.
3dafc3ae15cb35677945.id: Each berarti masing-masing satu per satu, jadi kita memakai has.

bac41d892481932b5d65.en: One cat sleeps, with -s. Many cats sleep, with no -s.
bac41d892481932b5d65.id: One cat sleeps, dengan -s. Many cats sleep, tanpa -s.

75c17493ff0c9d59d5f1.en: My sister is one person, like she. So we use has.
75c17493ff0c9d59d5f1.id: My sister adalah satu orang, seperti she. Jadi, kita memakai has.

7e47602427bda23e3cbd.en: Have goes with I, you, we and they, not with she.
7e47602427bda23e3cbd.id: Have dipakai dengan I, you, we, dan they, bukan dengan she.

a02ab81f49b67101d206.en: Are having is not the right form here.
a02ab81f49b67101d206.id: Are having bukan bentuk yang tepat di sini.

a4ac106e695029c25b84.en: Having needs a helper word, like is having.
a4ac106e695029c25b84.id: Having perlu kata bantu, seperti is having.

d8c63f57c408d484bbb3.en: Children is plural, so it takes are: the children are playing.
d8c63f57c408d484bbb3.id: Children itu jamak (plural), jadi memakai are: the children are playing.

fd4551c5ec76d29ff674.en: Dewi and Bayu are two people, like they. So we write have.
fd4551c5ec76d29ff674.id: Dewi dan Bayu adalah dua orang, seperti they. Jadi, kita menulis have.

7f5a417315751afff4fd.en: The subject is three mangoes, which is plural. So we say there are three mangoes.
7f5a417315751afff4fd.id: Subjeknya adalah three mangoes, yang jamak (plural). Jadi, kita berkata there are three mangoes.

8d85bb07de67a9b29d63.en: Is goes with one thing. Three mangoes is more than one.
8d85bb07de67a9b29d63.id: Is dipakai untuk satu benda. Three mangoes berarti lebih dari satu.

580e7668ae3ca36744e8.en: Was is for one thing in the past. This sentence is about now.
580e7668ae3ca36744e8.id: Was dipakai untuk satu benda pada masa lalu. Kalimat ini tentang sekarang.

c31206255ed43354499e.en: Be cannot stand alone as the verb here.
c31206255ed43354499e.id: Be tidak bisa berdiri sendiri sebagai kata kerja di sini.

f13393a2d4d28afbc56c.en: One bus stops. Many buses stop. I goes with am, and you goes with are.
f13393a2d4d28afbc56c.id: One bus stops. Many buses stop. I berpasangan dengan am, dan you berpasangan dengan are.

30ebc70a906f186fc69b.en: Each verb must match its subject: she walks, the dogs bark, he has.
30ebc70a906f186fc69b.id: Setiap kata kerja (verb) harus cocok dengan subjeknya: she walks, the dogs bark, he has.

5d3dffde61d443e02d1a.en: The class is acting as one group. The word its shows this, so we use has.
5d3dffde61d443e02d1a.id: The class bertindak sebagai satu kelompok. Kata its menunjukkan hal ini, jadi kita memakai has.

3950bd5ba221b745904e.en: Class is one group here, and its shows it is singular.
3950bd5ba221b745904e.id: Class di sini berarti satu kelompok, dan its menunjukkan bentuknya tunggal (singular).

b19e1175799f2d7daae8.en: Are goes with more than one. The word its shows one group.
b19e1175799f2d7daae8.id: Are dipakai untuk lebih dari satu. Kata its menunjukkan satu kelompok.

9a6ad879e8affe0e0db6.en: Were is the past and goes with more than one.
9a6ad879e8affe0e0db6.id: Were adalah bentuk lampau dan dipakai untuk lebih dari satu.

87695d17c2dcc9e60ea7.en: Use is with one main noun and are with more than one. The box of pencils is about one box.
87695d17c2dcc9e60ea7.id: Pakai is untuk satu kata benda (noun) utama dan are untuk lebih dari satu. The box of pencils membahas satu box.

cdc832dbbf8e611f9fc4.en: The subject is the girls, which is plural. It should be: the girls in my class like drawing.
cdc832dbbf8e611f9fc4.id: Subjeknya adalah the girls, yang jamak (plural). Seharusnya: the girls in my class like drawing.

ff02c9e52418af52ccf3.en: This one is correct. Two people go with are.
ff02c9e52418af52ccf3.id: Kalimat ini benar. Dua orang memakai are.

94053b97f4300ae41549.en: This one is correct. One uncle takes lives.
94053b97f4300ae41549.id: Kalimat ini benar. Satu uncle memakai lives.

f44ccabf529f8d41f851.en: This one is correct. Yuki is one person.
f44ccabf529f8d41f851.id: Kalimat ini benar. Yuki adalah satu orang.

477fe5f0dd2e93a63384.en: There are three people, like they. So the verb has no -s: live.
477fe5f0dd2e93a63384.id: Ada tiga orang, seperti they. Jadi, kata kerja (verb) tidak memakai -s: live.

106b213ac86c0ce7073d.en: The subject is two old trees, even though it comes after the verb. So we use are.
106b213ac86c0ce7073d.id: Subjeknya adalah two old trees, walaupun letaknya setelah kata kerja (verb). Jadi, kita memakai are.

5a701c0ace6964cafcb6.en: The subject comes after the verb here. Two trees is plural.
5a701c0ace6964cafcb6.id: Di sini subjeknya ada sesudah kata kerja. Two trees berbentuk jamak (plural).

5bbcee933c64d5f362a0.en: Was is for one thing, and two trees is more than one.
5bbcee933c64d5f362a0.id: Was dipakai untuk satu benda, dan two trees berarti lebih dari satu.

8c040038a87d134a385d.en: Stands goes with one thing, not two trees.
8c040038a87d134a385d.id: Stands dipakai untuk satu benda, bukan two trees.

34d01e9f22cf5df34bd3.en: The boy plays (one boy) and the books belong (many books). In the others, the verb matches the wrong noun.
34d01e9f22cf5df34bd3.id: The boy plays (one boy) dan the books belong (many books). Pada kalimat lainnya, kata kerja (verb) cocok dengan kata benda (noun) yang salah.

2a0032961265e7862386.en: Girls is plural, so it should be who sit.
2a0032961265e7862386.id: Girls berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi seharusnya who sit.

b2156686319f1899715d.en: The main noun is list, which is one thing. It should be hangs.
b2156686319f1899715d.id: Kata benda utamanya adalah list, yang berarti satu benda. Seharusnya hangs.

d5bad5fec89e4ac78937.en: The main noun is price, which is one thing. It should be is.
d5bad5fec89e4ac78937.id: Kata benda utamanya adalah price, yang berarti satu hal. Seharusnya is.

3368103b7a7b01da1256.en: Everyone takes a singular verb: has. Both is plural, so we use are.
3368103b7a7b01da1256.id: Everyone memakai kata kerja tunggal (singular verb): has. Both itu jamak (plural), jadi kita memakai are.

c1d27122040f55da0d6c.en: News looks plural but is singular, so it is correct. Scissors and trousers are plural.
c1d27122040f55da0d6c.id: News terlihat jamak (plural), tetapi sebenarnya tunggal (singular), jadi kalimat itu benar. Scissors dan trousers itu jamak.

a52f508ffbde5e1fb3d6.en: Scissors is a pair of blades, so it takes are.
a52f508ffbde5e1fb3d6.id: Scissors terdiri atas sepasang mata pisau, jadi memakai are.

006e65bb083d176ffb87.en: Mathematics is the name of one subject, so it takes is.
006e65bb083d176ffb87.id: Mathematics adalah nama satu mata pelajaran, jadi memakai is.

a362f4dd28c423446270.en: Trousers is a pair, so it takes are.
a362f4dd28c423446270.id: Trousers dianggap sepasang, jadi memakai are.

70c35137d192892b2535.en: Amara's team is one group, so it takes is. Its players are more than one, so they take are.
70c35137d192892b2535.id: Amara's team adalah satu kelompok, jadi memakai is. Its players lebih dari satu, jadi memakai are.

33648b1cb77f7dfdacaf.en: Team here is one group (its), and players is plural. These are the wrong way round.
33648b1cb77f7dfdacaf.id: Team di sini berarti satu kelompok (its), dan players berbentuk jamak (plural). Keduanya terbalik.

8d132bc23abfa2ef9ec5.en: Players is plural, so it needs are.
8d132bc23abfa2ef9ec5.id: Players berbentuk jamak (plural), jadi perlu are.

b4d4545acb1ff53b408e.en: Team is one group, shown by its, so it needs is.
b4d4545acb1ff53b408e.id: Team adalah satu kelompok, terlihat dari its, jadi perlu is.

e13e2787c93f048e456d.en: Either means one or the other of two. You choose one road, and both lead to the beach.
e13e2787c93f048e456d.id: Either berarti salah satu dari dua. Kamu memilih satu jalan, dan keduanya menuju pantai.

8bee652ebb9acb990e40.en: Neither would mean you could take no road.
8bee652ebb9acb990e40.id: Neither berarti kamu tidak bisa mengambil jalan mana pun.

c2cf10da26ac2b973d06.en: Both needs a plural noun, as in both roads.
c2cf10da26ac2b973d06.id: Both perlu kata benda jamak (plural), seperti both roads.

a723b1284600e7174ced.en: All is used for three or more things.
a723b1284600e7174ced.id: All dipakai untuk tiga benda atau lebih.

4bead6de78568caf88be.en: Neither means not one and not the other. Neither pen works because the ink is dry in both.
4bead6de78568caf88be.id: Neither berarti yang satu tidak dan yang lain juga tidak. Neither pen works karena tinta pada kedua pulpen itu sudah kering.

749cb88cbb3cc0db9314.en: Both is used with a plural noun, as in both pens.
749cb88cbb3cc0db9314.id: Both dipakai dengan kata benda jamak (plural), seperti both pens.

af48d070a2bc7e12b739.en: Either pen would work. The ink is dry, so they do not.
af48d070a2bc7e12b739.id: Either pen berarti pulpen mana saja bisa dipakai. Tintanya kering, jadi keduanya tidak bisa dipakai.

c716b740585fe5a34838.en: Every is used for three or more things.
c716b740585fe5a34838.id: Every dipakai untuk tiga benda atau lebih.

f7937de0ac3663268238.en: Either, neither and both are used for two things. All, several and none are used for bigger groups.
f7937de0ac3663268238.id: Either, neither, dan both dipakai untuk dua benda. All, several, dan none dipakai untuk kelompok yang lebih besar.

b274430828f9a4c65fa0.en: Both means two, so it takes were. The sentence reads: Both of the doors were open.
b274430828f9a4c65fa0.id: Both berarti dua, jadi memakai were. Kalimatnya berbunyi: Both of the doors were open.

306f18135f1e28d342c8.en: Both goes with are because it means two. Neither goes with is because it means not one of the two.
306f18135f1e28d342c8.id: Both berpasangan dengan are karena berarti dua. Neither berpasangan dengan is karena berarti tidak satu pun dari keduanya.

cbe280d24e88de91e5f1.en: Neither and either take is in standard writing, because they mean one boy at a time. Both takes are.
cbe280d24e88de91e5f1.id: Neither dan either memakai is dalam tulisan baku, karena artinya satu per satu anak laki-laki. Both memakai are.

6ba17747fb6639e51e20.en: In standard writing, neither takes is.
6ba17747fb6639e51e20.id: Dalam tulisan baku, neither memakai is.

19a1541e1bb6fe216b01.en: In standard writing, either takes is.
19a1541e1bb6fe216b01.id: Dalam tulisan baku, either memakai is.

71dc52f3643e88bd4304.en: I takes am, she takes is, and we and the dogs take are.
71dc52f3643e88bd4304.id: I memakai am, she memakai is, dan we serta the dogs memakai are.

451c9fe5bd7187afada8.en: I goes with was. My friends is plural, so it goes with were.
451c9fe5bd7187afada8.id: I berpasangan dengan was. My friends itu jamak (plural), jadi berpasangan dengan were.

cb39b57134a64cc94735.en: One cat is a singular subject, so the verb takes s: sleeps.
cb39b57134a64cc94735.id: One cat adalah subjek tunggal (singular), jadi kata kerja (verb) mendapat s: sleeps.

fdfce2eefe1e297084ef.en: Children is plural, so the verb should be play: The children play in the park.
fdfce2eefe1e297084ef.id: Children itu jamak (plural), jadi kata kerjanya (verb) seharusnya play: The children play in the park.

809fdbfa8b781b450c4c.en: My friends and I is more than one person, so we use are.
809fdbfa8b781b450c4c.id: My friends and I berarti lebih dari satu orang, jadi kita memakai are.

ac3a6ddcbf206501b544.en: The subject is box, which is singular, so the verb is is: The box of pencils is on the table.
ac3a6ddcbf206501b544.id: Subjeknya adalah box, yang tunggal (singular), jadi kata kerjanya (verb) adalah is: The box of pencils is on the table.

fc81f3d1e11e31b738c6.en: Books is plural, so the verb is are.
fc81f3d1e11e31b738c6.id: Books itu jamak (plural), jadi kata kerjanya (verb) adalah are.

5a9d651ef2719a94243a.en: Dogs is plural, so we use are.
5a9d651ef2719a94243a.id: Dogs itu jamak (plural), jadi kita memakai are.
